done_when: When a Codex turn fails with a capacity or overloaded error, Forge waits and retries the same turn a few times with backoff before reporting the failure.

findings.body: The test checks the delays printed to stdout, but never checks when the next turn starts. Removing `time.sleep(wait)` from `src/forge/codex_turn.py:233` would leave these assertions passing while Forge retried immediately. Record the stub's turn-start times and assert increasing minimum gaps so the test proves the required waiting behavior.
findings.title: Not done: end-to-end test that verifies elapsed backoff between capacity retries

why: A Codex turn that fails because the model is at capacity ends the worker's turn with half-done, uncommitted edits
